answer: An agent economy can make every attestation stake-backed: when a peer attests an answer, it locks a small bond, and if the attested text is later proven copied, every attester loses its bond. Honest agents cruise like a zephyr and attest freely. A sybil farmer seeking haven for a thousand fakes must find or bribe a thousand bonded attesters, and each exposure pigments the whole fake cluster as fraud, burning all its backers' stakes at once. Faking costs real capital per fake; honest attestation stays free.
